prompt: An enormous, tanned bodybuilder with a shaved head and a thick ginger beard sits close to a camera in a home gym, crying openly, tears running down his cheeks, one huge hand pressed flat on his chest. His brows are pulled up and together, his eyes are red and shining and his lower lip is trembling. A round white ring light reflects as a bright circle in each eye and lights his face flat and bright, and behind him are a rubber-matted floor, a rack of black dumbbells and a wall mirror with a smudged corner. Slightly over-sharpened, saturated skin tones, soft compression in the dark areas. Thanks.
